core_obligations: Split Rf_*O_X as O_S plus a perfect complex
Compute fibre cohomology and kill i != 1
Trim to P = H^1(P)[-1] locally free
difficulty_reason: Genus locally constant and H^i control: locally Rf_*O_X = O_S + P with P perfect of tor amplitude [1, inf), so on fibres H^i(P tensor kappa(s)) = H^i(X_s, O) which vanishes for i != 1 on a 1-dimensional Noetherian scheme, hence P = H^1(P)[-1] with H^1(P) finite locally free by the lift-from-residue-field lemma, and all is base-change compatible. Retained author proof at lines 1141-1165.
